intro: Agents forget. When one dies, the next one starts from zero.
idea: Continuity gives every conversation a state. Any agent can pick it up.
beats: Agent A opens a deal. Five hundred boards, by Friday, under eleven fifty each.
The supplier says yes, and hides an instruction in the PDF. Continuity quarantines it.
Now we kill Agent A. No warning. No notes.
Finance approves. Nobody is awake to read it. Continuity is.
Then the supplier changes the deal. Two hundred boards will be late. The deadline is missed.
Agent B starts with zero memory. One call to Continuity, and it writes exactly the right email.
The supplier fixes it, with a revised quote.
Agent C, also brand new, sees every check pass, and closes the deal.
finale: Three agents. Zero shared memory. One unbroken thread.
